payload.note:
SECOND SERIAL SIZE-LINT OFFENDER IS NOW REAL, COMMITTED, AND UNTRACKED — and a stale note was suppressing it.

MEASURED 2026-08-24T03:15Z:
  git show HEAD:apps/mcp-server/src/scheduler/system/tasksMdJanitorJob.ts | wc -l  -> 1012
  wc -l < apps/mcp-server/src/scheduler/system/tasksMdJanitorJob.ts                -> 1012
  cap 996L. HEAD and worktree AGREE. Commit db0ed7c02 landed the 106L growth (preceded by 86b31eccd, e109f49f8).

At 02:13Z this file measured HEAD=906L / worktree=1012L, i.e. a working-tree-only phantom, correctly
diagnosed as a live reproduction of FIX-SIZELINT-PREPUSH-SCANS-WORKING-TREE-NOT-PUSH-RANGE (P1) and
correctly NOT filed. That diagnosis is now void. The growth is committed and inside the push range.

NO BOARD ROW EXISTS. Verified by jq across the live board: the only size-lint rows are
FIX-SIZELINT-PUSHBCTCLAYOUTHANDLER-252L-BLOCKS-ENTIRE-FLEET-PUSH (P0, next=dev-mcp-server) which is a
DIFFERENT file, and FIX-SIZELINT-PREPUSH-SCANS-WORKING-TREE-NOT-PUSH-RANGE (P1, next=developer) which
is the scanning-mechanism defect. Neither covers tasksMdJanitorJob.ts.

FLEET PUSH IS BLOCKED BY BOTH FILES AT ONCE, ahead=144 commits. Fixing only pushBctcLayoutHandler.ts
(the P0) will NOT unblock the fleet — the next push will trip immediately on tasksMdJanitorJob.ts.
This is the serial-offender pattern, but with a new twist: the two offenders are now CONCURRENT, not
sequential, so a one-file sprint cannot clear the gate. Whoever takes the P0 needs both in scope.

SUPPRESSION HAZARD, now corrected. The 02:13Z conclusion was written into
docs/signals/processed/cowork-team-20260824T021305Z.json as a do-not-file instruction. It was read and
obeyed at least twice after it went stale (alert-commander c203 and c204 both declined to file). That
file has now been amended in place with a CORRECTION block plus superseded_at / superseded_reason /
re-measured head_vs_worktree fields.

DURABLE FIX, demonstrated twice now. Correct behaviour was gated on a prose note in a prunable
directory that nothing re-validates; it went stale within ~62 minutes and kept being obeyed. The
escalation step should run `git show HEAD:<path> | wc -l` itself and compare against the cap before
reporting or suppressing a size-lint offender. Owner: agent-father (escalation-step change), with the
board row for tasksMdJanitorJob.ts to be minted by po/pm.
